fdn_hall.baseline: #72 part 1, 2026-10-26, local VS 2022 Release build (windows-msvc), median of 7 quiet runs (R 0.602-0.659), T_ref 10.6-11.1 ms
fdn_hall.headroom: about 4.4x the measured 0.68 %: 8-line FDN, 4 diffuser stages (32 delay taps + 4 Hadamard), 8 modulated linear-interpolated reads with std::sin LFOs, stereo; reverb is one of the heavier non-amp blocks, so the ceiling leaves room for the block wrapper (pre-delay, filters, mix) in part 2

plate_tank.baseline: #72 part 3, 2026-10-26, local VS 2022 Release build (windows-msvc), median of 7 runs (R 0.135-0.143) on a lightly loaded machine, T_ref about 11 ms
plate_tank.headroom: about 6.5x the measured 0.155 %: Dattorro figure-eight tank, 4 input allpasses + 2 modulated allpasses + 2 allpasses + 4 delays, 14 output taps, one sin/cos LFO pair per sample; one plate per Reverb block

shimmer_tank.baseline: #73 part 2, 2026-10-27, local VS 2022 Release build (windows-msvc-ci), 7 runs on a heavily loaded machine: r0 = fdn_hall r0 x the median per-run shimmer/fdn ratio 1.709 (1.27-3.06); raw R median 1.933
shimmer_tank.headroom: about 3.7x the estimated 1.1 %: the hall FdnTank plus, per channel, a 2-tap grain shifter (2 Catmull-Rom reads, 2 sin, a coarse-to-fine WSOLA search of about 8 k multiply-adds per splice, 50 splices/s at an octave), 3 SVFs, 2 allpasses and a tanh; the splice search was 61 k multiply-adds before the coarse pass (3.3x the FDN)

spring_tank.baseline: #73 part 1, 2026-10-27, local VS 2022 Release build (windows-msvc-ci), 7 runs on a heavily loaded machine (fdn_hall read 1.86x its r0): r0 = fdn_hall r0 x the median per-run spring/fdn ratio 1.097 (0.88-1.21); raw R median 1.218
spring_tank.headroom: the same 3 % ceiling as fdn_hall, which it costs about the same as: 2 springs x (100 stretched + 40 plain allpasses), 4 interleaved serial chains, 4 modulated linear reads, one 2-pole SVF per spring; interleaving the chains cut it 2.2x (from 2.5x the FDN)

reverb_block.baseline: #72 part 2, 2026-10-26, local VS 2022 Release build (windows-msvc), median of 7 quiet runs (R 0.641-0.686), T_ref about 10.5 ms
reverb_block.headroom: about 4.3x the measured 0.70 %: the hall FdnTank (fdn_hall) plus fractional pre-delay, two TPT one-poles per channel, mix and enable ramps, stereo; the same 3 % ceiling as the tank, since the wrapper adds about 4 %

reverb_shimmer_block.baseline: #73 part 3, 2026-10-27, local VS 2022 Release build (windows-msvc-ci) on a heavily loaded machine: r0 = shimmer_tank r0 (1.082) + the block wrapper (reverb_block r0 - fdn_hall r0 = 0.037); the 2 quietest of 7 runs gave 1.07-1.13 against fdn_hall's r0
reverb_shimmer_block.headroom: the shimmer tank's 4 % ceiling: the wrapper adds about 3 % to the tank, as for reverb_block; shimmer is the heaviest mode (only the active engine runs, plus the outgoing one during a 50 ms fade)
